lineage.strategy: Add a contracted launch/deployment path for Berlin-built Pelican hardware rather than repeat facility-opening evidence.

observations.fact: Planet Labs Germany and Isar Aerospace signed a launch agreement for a high-resolution Pelican satellite, with additional joint missions planned and a target launch within 12 months of contract signing.
Planet states the Pelican for this mission will be manufactured at its new Berlin facility, directly linking the European manufacturing expansion to an identified deployment path.

risks.risk: The launch target depends on both new Berlin manufacturing execution and Isar Aerospace launch readiness; a signed launch agreement does not prove on-time orbital deployment or customer economics.

unknowns.unknown: Contract value, launch price, satellite production cost, mission customer economics and realized launch date are not disclosed.

recommendation: Use as source-addressed evidence that Berlin capacity has an identified mission path; stress launch/manufacturing dependency and keep economics unknown.
